steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each consultant is placed by utilisation against target, and whether a timesheet exists.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Utilisation above 100 percent
findings.fix: Check the hours and correct the record

findings.title: Target not stated for the period

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] consultant-b.csv:12  Utilisation above 100 percent.
       Fix: Check the hours and correct the record.
[medium] target.md:19  Consultant with no timesheet.
       Fix: Get the timesheet.
[low] consultant-d.csv:26  Target not stated for the period.
       Fix: State the target.
Not checked: Quality of the work.
pros: Checks a utilisation above 100 percent, and a consultant with no timesheet.
cons: Not checked: Quality of the work.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-utilisation-report skill on the records for this review.
